notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines CMSG_LIST_INVENTORY/BUY_ITEM/SELL_ITEM/BUYBACK_ITEM/REPAIR_ITEM and the SMSG_LIST_INVENTORY/BUY_ITEM/SELL_ITEM/BUY_FAILED parses with the buy/sell result vocabularies. MSUI implements all five sends (incl. buyback's absolute slot 69-80 and repair's itemGuid==0 repair-all) and all four parses in Net/VendorState.cs + WorldSession.cs, wired to the merchant UI with buyback rendered from the PLAYER_VENDOR_BUYBACK descriptor fields as Benilla does.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The mechanical pre-pass flagged CMSG_REPAIR_ITEM as missing; it is actually implemented (WorldSession.RepairItem/BuildRepairItemBody, used by the vendor repair-all flow) - a pre-pass false negative.
